text:
Gentlemen,

I have read many news reports about cigarettes.

I, too, would like to protest. I have just turned (13) in July 12. Almost at that time, I decided that I consider to be a "PRESENT" from the tobacco industry; my grandfather (the only one I have left, the other died of lung cancer), had his 2nd heart attack. Before Thanksgiving, he had his first one. He had successfully quit the stimulant you mention, Doctor. His doctors say that if he hadn't, he wouldn't live to have a 2nd heart attack. My grandmother also smokes and has very high blood pressure. I do not neither father smoke. Many people consider me intelligent above average and while I lie awake some nights listening to my men heck and struggle to breathe, I tell myself just what I think of you and the others. I wanted to write you a nasty letter, but, as Gil said, it's hard to fight the rich tobacco industry. :)
